2609.24275.title: Structure Before Sampling: Community-Aware Core-Set Selection for Data-Efficient Text-to-Speech
2609.24275.paper_summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) corpora are costly to record, yet many utterances add little new phonetic information. Core-set selection reduces this cost by choosing a small training subset under a fixed audio-duration budget. We represent a corpus as a phonotactic graph that links each utterance to its most phonemically similar ones, and we first test whether this graph has structure. In Bangla and English corpora, its clustering is 199 and 56 times that of a size-matched random graph, and its modularity is more than twice that of a degree-preserving random graph. We then propose Community Representative, a selector that samples across graph communities and spreads its choices within each one, starting from utterances rich in rare phonemes. At every budget and in both languages, it covers more rare phoneme bigrams than random and entropy-based selection, and this lead holds on held-out utterances. TTS models trained on its 20% core-sets have a significantly lower character error rate (CER) than models trained on equal-duration random or entropy-based subsets in both languages. When all models train for the same number of epochs, the Bangla core-set model also outperforms full-corpus training (3.93% vs. 4.47% CER) with 4.5x less training time.
2609.24275.paper_summary_zh: 文本轉語音（TTS）語料庫的錄製成本高昂，但許多語句所提供的新音韻信息卻很少。核心集選擇通過在固定的音頻時長預算下選擇一小部分訓練子集來降低這一成本。我們將語料庫表示為一個音韻圖，它將每個語句與其最相似的音素語句相連接，並首先測試這個圖是否具有結構。在孟加拉語和英語語料庫中，其聚類程度分別是大小匹配的隨機圖的199倍和56倍，且其模塊度是保持度隨機圖的兩倍以上。然後，我們提出了社區代表，一種在圖社區中進行抽樣並在每個社區內擴展其選擇的選擇器，從富含稀有音素的語句開始。在每個預算下，並且在這兩種語言中，它涵蓋的稀有音素雙音節比隨機和基於熵的選擇更多，這一優勢在保留的語句中也保持不變。基於其20%核心集訓練的TTS模型在兩種語言中具有顯著較低的字符錯誤率（CER），相比於基於相等時長的隨機或基於熵的子集訓練的模型。當所有模型訓練相同的時期時，孟加拉語核心集模型的表現也超過了全語料庫訓練（3.93%對4.47% CER），且訓練時間少了4.5倍。
